title: Stocks Rally After Nvidia Signals 70% Revenue Growth: Aug. 27, 2026
summary: Stocks are rallying in response to Nvidia posting a beat-and-raise yesterday evening while signaling nosebleed level demand from customers that just can’t get enough of its high-grade semiconductor chips.
